verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-services platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no mention of an MCP server, API, or agent connectivity. The llms.txt probe offers only guidance for AI crawlers, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
